items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Santo, Pecora, Paul and Boyce Brown was the front line.

ctx.x: Simeon never worked at Harry's Bar then.
No, no, no, no. Santo, Pecora, Paul and Boyce Brown was the front line. You remember Boyce? Yeah. He played alto. And of course, Jess Stacy and Pat Patterson.
We were talking about the OK date then. Harry's New Yorker.
